support: Partner preview: best-effort support, no production commitment. Frozen fields in the pinned component files are the contract; a breaking change to a documented surface opens a new Distribution line, announced in advance.

surfaces.contracts: additive — CorkMarketCreator joins cork-periphery (new contract, both chains, same CREATE2 address); every phoenix, market-registry and ForSelf address and codehash from v0.1-rc.1 is unchanged, re-verified on-chain 2026-08-14.
surfaces.cli-mcp: changed — 0.1.0-rc.3 -> 0.2.0-rc.2; the venue premium migration (premium_annualized) and the full change record are in the pinned CHANGELOG entries for 0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2.
surfaces.apis: changed — 0.1.4 -> 0.3.6. Machine diff of the two vendored OpenAPI documents: all 16 pinned 0.1.4 paths are superseded by the canonical /<module>/v<n> form (0 paths carried unchanged; the legacy /v1/* form is still served live through a deprecation-tagged rewrite bridge, outside this pin's covered surface); the registry and indexing modules join the covered surface; the rollover module exists in the schema but is not covered; the legacy `premium` field is removed 2026-08-17 with R16 notice in-band.
surfaces.manifests: changed — service pins gain routeMajors, liveSpec and the availability verify model (served >= pinned, covered route majors still served, no breaking drift on covered paths); superseded component pins retire from live assertion via supersededBy and keep their immutable checks.

integrationSuite.decision: No cross-component integration suite exists; waived by the distribution owner for the second and final time (2026-08-13, recorded decision). The next cut requires a real cross-component run. The Distribution keeps its candidate (-rc) name.
integrationSuite.nearestEvidence: The live loop has been filling on Base against exactly this pinned contract set since 2026-08-10 (JIT market creation and fills through the market-registry 0.3.3 adapter into phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1, agents executing through Safe + session keys); cork-cli 0.2.0-rc.2 shipped through its release gate (two independent byte-identical builds, four-platform smoke, MCP handshake) against the 0.3.x API surfaces; the ForSelf integration flow is fork-proven end-to-end against the pinned adapters.

externalDependencies._note: Third-party contracts the pinned set calls into. Not Cork components, but an integrator's threat model includes them, so the pin records exactly which ones this set was built against.

deterministic-deployment-factory.note: CREATE2 address identity across chains depends on this factory.

announcements: GitHub Releases on each pinned repository are the notice channel for cuts, deprecations and removals. Pending removal with published notice: the legacy `premium` field leaves cork-api on 2026-08-17 (noticed in the cork-cli 0.2.0 CHANGELOG and in every limit-orders response's warnings[] channel).
knownIssues: Rollover is not part of this Distribution. The rollover route family exists in the pinned cork-api schema and rollover contracts exist on both chains, but neither carries any promise here; rollover joins a later Distribution after it has run end to end.
Admin and operational timelocks run at a 0-second delay — a documented fact of this partner-preview deployment.
CorkMarketCreator's on-chain version() reads "0.1.0" instead of its repo version — recorded in the cork-periphery pin; the codehash identifies the build.
scopeNotes: The registry read API joined this Distribution as the cork-api registry module (/registry/v1); the v0.1-rc.1 scope note excluding it is closed.

cork-api is a hosted service with one live deployment updated in place: served versions above the pin within the same y are expected and non-breaking by rule (R10). The pin certifies the snapshot at the tag; the availability verify asserts the covered surface stays served and unbroken.
Naming: a Distribution line is named after its main component — this is the phoenix line; v0.2 is a new point on line 0 (contracts unchanged, no covered surface broken).
